Those weary of waiting can rest on mahogany chairs that sit before a large hanging tapestry.

node.name: Hair Apparent, Sales Floor
node.description: Lush velvet panels cover the walls and ceiling of the room, while thick carpets cover the floors, dampening the sound of any footsteps. Simple lanterns illuminate the wares, the scented oil within them permeating the area with heady spice notes.

node.name: Famous Last Words
node.description: Canvas walls are edged with a design of interlocking cogs that runs along the bottom edge as well as the edges of the tent flap. A few clerks mingle with the crowds as they replenish stock and answer questions.

node.name: From Top to Bottom, Shoe Sales
node.description: A long slender oval-shaped room spreads out, significantly taller at one end than the other. Holes are drilled in a slant between the small end and the tall end, crossed through with a thick rope, looking somewhat like the interior of a boot. Leather patches are sewn together as a floor covering fashioned to be the sole. A tall twisting staircase rises out of the floor through the top, leading into an upper floor.

node.name: Suite of Sweets, The Cherry Pit
node.description: Cloth walls form a soft enclosure beneath a canopy adorned with strings of gaethzen blossoms. Layered grass mats cover the floor, carrying a faint earthy scent tinged with sweetness.

node.name: Suite of Sweets, The Lemon Grove
node.description: Fabric walls encircle the space, accented with pale yellow hangings and citrus motifs. Grass mats overlap across the floor, their subtle fragrance mingling with a delicate hint of lemon.

node.name: The Perfect Rose, Entrance
node.description: Fine rugs of braided silk cover the floors of this opulent tent, while the faint scent of vanilla spice wafts from candles burning on low tables. Clerks dressed in linen robes confer with their customers, murmuring in low tones amid an array of mannequins. The smiles on the customers' faces bespeak their satisfaction with the service they receive.

node.name: The Perfect Rose, Accessories
node.description: Finely crafted accessories rest upon various displays, each arranged with deliberate care. Polished mirrors reflect the soft radiance of suspended gaethzen lanterns, scattering muted light across the room. A few cushioned stools offer a comfortable place to linger while choosing the perfect finishing touch.

node.name: The Perfect Rose, Apparel
node.description: Dark polished wooden wardrobes spaced sedately about the room brim with a selection of richly designed garments. Plush fur rugs spread in abundance offer protection from the cold hard floor. Mirrors have been strategically placed to admire the many flattering views of an outfit, while delicate paper screens offer the more modest customers a place to dress.

node.name: Hashal's Haven
node.description: Surprisingly roomy and well appointed, the interior of the tent is draped in lavish tapestries embroidered with elaborate arabesques in shimmering gold thread. Gilded lanterns illuminate the many fine wares, while a burly S'Kra guard keeps a watchful eye on patrons.

node.name: Hashal's Haven, Reshalian Rainbow
node.description: The shop's airy pavilion is lined with woven mats and bright coral-hued draperies that ripple in the breeze. Shell-inlaid lanterns cast a pearly glow over displays of fine island wares, their scent mingling with salt and hibiscus. A lean S'Kra guard lounges nearby, watching each visitor with practiced ease.

node.name: Shades of Night, Showroom
node.description: Airy white linens drape circular walls, brightening the interior of the dark-colored tent while several sand-colored rugs cover the ground. Several branches are attached to the center support pole, a trio of lit gaethzen owlets lined up on each to cast a soft light over the area.

node.name: Shades of Night, Jewelry Junction
node.description: Tucked away from the main tent, this small alcove is just large enough to stand apart. A strand of small gaethzen orbs hangs above the merchandise, softly illuminating the area.

node.name: Shades of Night, Accessories Alcove
node.description: Tucked away from the main tent, this small alcove is just large enough to stand apart. A strand of small gaethzen orbs hangs above the merchandise, softly illuminating the area. A round gold-framed mirror is propped up on a spindly side table, ready for patron preening.

node.name: Tools of the Trader Redux, Salesfloor
node.description: The interior of this caravan is the epitome of organization -- there's a place for every item, and every item has a place. A cloak rack stands tall in one corner at the end of a counter, adorned with a multitude of fabulous garments draped from every side. Opposite the counter, a long table rests pushed up against the wall. To complete the symmetrical design, a trunk sits in the corner directly opposite the rack.

node.name: Lavender and Lace, All the Options
node.description: Fabric swatches in varied hues of purple blanket the walls, completely covering the metal beneath. Cascades of gauzy cloth hang from gaily painted poles, the folds drifting faintly in the air. Strands of glass beads and silk tassels sway overhead, scattering light across the soft textures that fill the cozy space.

node.name: Mighty Pillows, Sales
node.description: High overhead a latticework of interlocking poles holds up the exterior hides of the yurt. Thick woven mats cover the floor where racks and stands display the wares on offer.

node.name: Acaph's Acquisitions, Foyer
node.description: This simple entry is bare of any decorations save a large sign that dominates the center of the room and forces customers to squeeze around to continue into the shop. Due to the narrow walking space and those customers stopping to read the sign, there is much congestion and a waiting line to get inside.

node.name: Acaph's Acquisitions, Hall of Valor
node.description: The canvas walls of this narrow area have been painted to resemble stones and large faded tapestries hang on each side. Five armor racks shaped like humanoids display the wares available for purchase, with each rack displaying a message upon its base.

node.name: Acaph's Acquisitions, Wilderness Glade
node.description: The surrounding walls have been painted with an encompassing mural of a forested glade. Birds, squirrels, raccoons and other wildlife can be seen watching you from the various foilage.

node.name: Tea For Tamsine, Entrance
node.description: The entrance to this well-lit shop is framed in soft curtains of petalette, the shimmery rose-hued fabric complements the ivory and gold floral pattern that covers the walls. A small table rests next to the small hearth burning brightly in the center of the room, while a gilded drink cart sits in the corner.

node.name: Tea For Tamsine, Tea Time
node.description: The faintest whiff of oranges and black tea drifts in to the brightly lit room, the pleasant smell matching the room's interior. Polished cherry floorboards look clean enough to eat off of, not that the proprietor would recommend doing so. A broad black walnut kitchen counter takes up one wall, while a pair of lacquered tables sit in the far corner.

node.name: Tea For Tamsine, Kitchy Kitchens
node.description: The majority of the floor is covered by a grey and white chevron-striped rug, but along the edges of the room it's possible to make out the polished cherry boards gleaming below. An assortment of kitchen furniture is placed around the brightly lit room, each set to show off the fine craftsmanship that went into its creation.

node.name: Skyward Bound
node.description: Feathers embroidered on the tapestries that adorn the walls mimic the same feathers reproduced that adorn the oversized wings on display. Perched atop a puffy white cloud made of wool in the center of the room is a Merelew maiden dressed in a fae costume.

node.name: Furvever Homes, Cozy Kitten Cottages
node.description: Playful kittens are stenciled over the soft orchid-pink walls enclosing the small room, their bodies arranged in a variety of poses. A plush white rug stretches over the polished goldenoak floor. A small counter towards the back of the room is stacked with merchandise for sale.

node.name: Furever Homes, Pawsome Puppy Palaces
node.description: A lively mural spreads over two of the walls, its colorful imagery depicting a pack of hunting dogs bounding through tall trees after an unseen target. Muddy brown paw prints stenciled over the polished goldenoak floor create the impression that the chase started within the room.

node.name: Furever Homes, Pig-ture Perfect Properties
node.description: Joyful pigs in tutus and ballet slippers dance across the walls in this barnyard-themed room, while more are painted over the ceiling in acrobatic poses as though flying through the air. A beautifully painted cream-white counter accentuated with rose-gold accents highlights the dark walnut floor.

node.name: Furever Homes, Ratical Rodent Residences
node.description: Clean white walls enclose the room, while a trail of dark rat-prints meanders across the floor. Painted across the top of the walls is a series of delightful scenes of well-groomed rats playing on wheels, chasing one another around piles of woodchips, and piled up in a rodent-sized hammock for a decadent snooze.

node.name: Furever Homes, Palatial Primate Pads
node.description: A motif of monkeys dressed in formal evening wear dominates one wall, a detailed tableau of primates in silk gowns, tailcoats, and more as they dance and chat at a lively party. The rest of the room is done in shades of gold and purple to match the mischievous mammals, while a long darkwood counter sits off to one side.

node.name: Witchery, The Tunnel
node.description: Fastened to the walls and ceiling, dark grey tarps stretch downwards, creating a twisting tunnel that is illuminated by strings of gaethzen crescent moons. A structure, hidden beneath the tarps, rises upwards in the center of the passage, creating shelves and niches that further slow traffic.

node.name: Witchery, The Den
node.description: The maze-like tunnel ends here as it widens into a small chamber that is illuminated by strings of delicate gaethzen stars that criss-cross the ceiling. A witchclaw dresser, a silver wire cage, and some crystal hooks are found along the dark grey tarp walls.

node.name: Beard Envy, Sales
node.description: Full-length mirrors appear along the walls, making the area seem much bigger than it actually is. Shelving set up between each of the mirrors displays several busts wearing elaborate faux beards. Busy clerks wander about the area, straightening up displays and restocking supplies.

node.name: Obscured Visions, Entrance
node.description: Large sheets of paper are plastered all over the walls in a rather haphazard fashion, covered with complicated-looking mathematical formulas and equations. Breaking up the chaos a bit are elegant portraits, each one depicting a stern-faced Elothean in mage's robes.

node.name: Obscured Visions, Shadows
node.description: Crushed black velvet hung in this corner of the room has created a lustrous canopy, obscuring the log walls and draping elegantly overhead as an elaborate curtain. Candles placed upon small stands provide just enough light to see the wares set out.

node.name: Obscured Visions, Iron and Fire
node.description: Although the log walls of this small triangular shop are completely unadorned, they have been sanded smooth and polished to a deep luster. Burning in the center of the room is a low brazier made of solid iron, casting orange light over the nearby wares.

node.name: Nobody's Vault But Mine, Salesfloor
node.note: nobody's vault but mine|nobodys vault but mine
node.description: Seeminly infinite amounts of shelves, drawers, racks, and other storage units completely cover the walls and floors, allowing for a multitude of choices in organizing customer's hoards. A few clerks bustle about answering questions and keeping supplies restocked.

node.name: Masquer Aid, The Costume Cupboard
node.description: Three long, broad tables are lit by torches on the walls of the room. For those who feel uncomfortable in enclosed spaces, a big landscape of Dirge is hung on one wall, counterfeiting a window.

node.name: Storms of Silk, Front Showroom
node.description: Lavish banners of storm-grey and silver silks enfold the elegantly appointed foyer of this upscale storefront. High-collared Elothean salesmen glide tirelessly among the mannequins on the showroom floor, preaching the 'finest fashions from Katamba's Crescent to Moonstone Street' with dutiful and unflagging conviction. A stately notice has been posted near the passage leading north.

node.name: Storms of Silk, Passageway
node.description: A short hallway of lustrous copperwood paneling connects the shop's two main showrooms. With quiet dignity, a row of wooden mannequins display their more modest wares here for patrons of the well-to-do working class.

node.name: Storms of Silk, Back Showroom
node.description: Strings of gaethzen fireflies suspended among swaths of fiery orange silk create a cozy effect of artificial sunset here in the shop's rear showroom. Along the northern wall, a row of armored mannequins solemnly proffer their wares in the dusky light.

node.name: Abyssess as Usual, Tent
node.description: Shadows gather in the room's deepest corners, stretching across the walls like dark tendrils reaching toward an unseen abyss. The air feels heavy and still, while the dim light from the overhead lanterns barely illuminates the merchandise on display. Discreet salespeople dressed in the shop's signature fabrics stand ready to answer questions.

node.name: Simply Essential, Sales Room
node.description: Yellow silk fabric casts a golden glow over everything in the room. Painted canvas covers the floor, held down at each corner by intricately crafted and brightly polished brass lamps. A painted paper screen stands in one corner, hiding it from view.

node.name: Simply Essential, Side Room
node.description: Plum-hued silks drape the area in an attempt to disguise the drab metal walls. A large bear hide covers the floor beneath the brass lanterns that hang overhead. Several large pillows are gathered at the center of the room, providing a comfortable spot to rest during the day's shopping.

node.name: Ohnomo's Kimonos, Salesfloor
node.description: Whitewashed walls are covered with shelves and racks of merchandise just waiting for the Master Tailor to customize. A harried clerk shuffles between the backroom and the salesfloor as they struggle to keep the store stocked.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Sales Floor
node.description: Panels of ayabere cover the walls, their deep azure grain lustrous under the light of ornate metal sconces affixed at even intervals around the room. With head and teeth still intact, a massive korograth hide rug cushions every footfall along the floor. A polished haon libations table is centrally located amidst oiled leather couches, allowing patrons a place to relax and converse while taking a break from perusing the wares amid mannequins of every race -- including Merelew.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Amiable Arrangements
node.description: Walls of dark burgundy feature a leafy vine trim painted in forest green both along the ceiling and baseboards. A round island built from mahogany serves as a focal point, centered in the middle of the room and surrounded by several thick lionskin rugs upon the hardwood floor. Hanging overhead, a wrought iron chandelier supporting a collection of glowing candles illuminates everything on display.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Formal Fellow
node.description: Black satin walls envelop the area in sobering shades, and a sleek golden gryphon rug accentuates the hardwood floor underfoot. Flickering candlelight scatters about the room from the crystal chandelier, refracted through multifaceted teardrops dangling above. The pinpoints of light more than adequately illuminate the collection of men's finery for sale.

node.name: Behind the Mask, Foyer
node.description: Jewel-toned silks drape this area of the shop, creating a foyer in which the artisan has chosen to display numerous individual masks available for purchase. Two sets of cushioned hooks line the side walls, and a table draped in velvet rests directly opposite the door. A single lantern hanging from the ceiling provides light for shoppers.

Jewel-toned silks drape this area of the shop, creating a foyer in which the artisan has chosen to display numerous individual masks available for purchase. Two sets of cushioned hooks line the side walls, and a table draped in velvet rests directly opposite the flap. A single lantern hanging from the ceiling provides light for shoppers.

node.name: Behind the Mask, Treasures
node.description: Black silks drape this area of the shop. The light from the lantern overhead shines on the masks featured in the cases, and is scattered in a sparkling display of color by the inlaid gemstones in the artisan's creations.

node.name: Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Tobacco Showroom
node.description: Bundles of assorted tobacco leaves hang from ropes stretched taut between the tent poles, providing an assortment of aromas throughout the area. Suspended frosted glass lanterns cast a steady, diffused light across the displays of merchandise arranged in the center of the room.

node.name: Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Cigarillo Showroom
node.description: Layers of thick vented canvas keep this small room cool and dim, muffling the sounds from beyond the tent. A woven rug patterned in rust, brown, and muted green spreads beneath the displays, its repeating diamond motif grounding the otherwise simple space.

node.name: Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Cigar Showroom
node.description: Red glass lanterns hung on the canvas-lined poles bathe the displays in a warm crimson glow. A cloudy lavender haze lingers above a pair of padded benches, evidence left from shoppers stopping to relax and sample one of the tobacco products sold here.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Genial Gentleman
node.description: Like a dense coat of mist, layers of glossy grey velvet cover the bright room's walls. Contrasting attractively with the dark hardwood flooring, a luxurious spotted jaguar rug is positioned between several sets of item displays. Filigreed silver sconces provide ample lighting for shopping patrons to view the wares for sale.

node.name: Wedding Belles, Foyer
node.description: A sense of lightness and elegance pervades the room, helped by the richness of the ivory silk-covered walls. Silver sconces jut out from the walls, holding candles out from polished reflectors. A small side table against one wall holds some refreshments, and white chairs stand against the two flanking walls.

node.name: Wedding Belles, With This Ring
node.description: Subtle but bright lighting ensures that the clientele of this shop can properly appreciate the exquisite merchandise on offering. Pale birch paneling along the walls adds to the general feeling of light and warmth. Three display cases - trimmed in teak, ebony, and cherry - hold pride of place in the center of the salesfloor.

node.name: Wedding Belles, Artful Accouterments
node.description: Lit chandeliers provide light now that night has descended, illuminating the cream-colored walls and pale pine floor planking. Mannequins stand in various poses in one corner. Large floor to ceiling mirrors allow for the trying on of the merchandise before purchasing.

Skylights admit light that pours over the cream-colored walls and pale pine planking on the floor. Mannequins stand in various poses in one corner of the room. Large floor to ceiling mirrors allow for the trying on of the merchandise before purchasing.

node.name: Wedding Belles, Bridal Suite
node.description: Instead of wood, the walls are covered in an off-white silk with a subtle shifting pattern of moire watermarks. A tri-fold mirror stands in one corner while mannequins garbed in luscious fabrics display the shop's bridal wares. Delicate lamps scattered throughout the area provide copious illumination of the designs and details.

node.name: Wedding Belles, Dapper Designs
node.description: Deeply padded leather armchairs provide spots for lounging and resting before further shopping. Dark wood paneling of various woods run vertically along the walls to the white plasterwork of the ceiling. Large chandeliers dangle from the ceiling, illuminating the tables placed in the center of the room.

node.name: The Stylish Stallion, Salesroom
node.description: Weathered brinewood boards have been nailed together to form a paneling that totally covers the walls and ceiling. One side of the room has been painted with a row of horse stalls, complementing the other images painted around the room to recreate the appearance of a public stable. A layer of straw carpets the floor, releasing its grassy scent into the air when stepped on by shoppers perusing the merchandise displayed for sale.

node.name: The Stylish Stallion, Reins and Regalia
node.description: Rough brinewood boards line the walls and ceiling, their seams sealed by years of use. Painted scenes of horse stalls extend along one side, blending with whimsical murals of seahorses. Straw covers the floor, releasing a clean grassy scent beneath the steps of shoppers browsing the tack and gear on display.

node.name: Seamwright's Fancy, Glittering Gallery
node.description: The rough texture of the ivory-washed stone walls is softened by colorful bolts of fabric stacked on various shelves around the room. Brinewood planks form a smooth, silvery floor that gleams faintly while subtle scents of essential oils mingle in the air to create a faintly herbal aroma.

node.name: Gum As You Are, Shop
node.description: Brightly painted an eye-searing pink, the canvas walls enclose a spacious area with many shelves and racks displaying the various flavors and colors on offer. Customers mill about, talking excitedly while blowing bubbles with their purchases. Most of the clerks are busy with helping customers but a few others, with sour expressions, attempt to keep the floors and surfaces clear of used merchandise.

node.name: Spinning Down the House, Salesfloor
node.description: Large glass tanks line the walls, much like those used for pet fish. Instead of fish, however, these vats contain a multitude of small enchanted items zipping around randomly while awaiting purchase by customers desiring new floating accessories to circle their heads. A few clerks stand ready to help buyers with their purchases.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Refined Rustic
node.description: Painted a soil brown and dappled with rich earth tones, the canvas-covered walls match perfectly with the dark hardwood floor. Wooden baseboards and ceiling trim of sandy beige complement the furry red leucro rug that decorates the room. Housed in frosted glass, candles in brass-edged holders shed light around the area for the goods on display.

node.name: The Male Persuasion, Dapper Dandy
node.description: In shades a bit more cheerful than the rest of the shop, the walls feature a silky covering of light pink swirled with grey striations. Spread across the hardwood floor, a plush clouded arzumos rug enhances the eccentric elegance of the room's decor. Soft light flickers onto the various displays from freestanding candelabras placed strategically around the area.

node.name: Stabbaticals, Sales Floor
node.description: Billowy white banners are draped along the walls, framing the wooden pegs and hooks affixed at even intervals around the room. A cluster of tables rests upon a dark blue rug stretched over the polished oak floor. Running along the back wall is an intricate mural of a battlefield strewn with broken weaponry and fallen bodies.

node.name: Home for the Fireplace, Showroom
node.description: Exhibited back to back in the center of the room are a number of displays of the various fireplaces available in the shop. More are set against the paneled walls.

node.name: Scentsations, Sweet Senses
node.description: Pure white walls enclose the airy confines of the sales floor. Faint scents waft through the area, a bouquet of mingled aromas that blends into an overall impression of pleasure and delight. Across one wall stands a counter, its plain ash wood unrelieved by any ornamentation.

node.name: Scentsations, Once and Floral
node.description: Tiles on the floor form a stylized floral design in black and white with the same blossom theme repeated on the carved baseboards and crown moulding of the whitewashed walls. A plain birch counter stands against a wall, showing the shop's wares without any distractions from the furnishings.

node.name: Scentsations, Seasonal Scents
node.description: Thin black stripes alternate with wide white planks in the floor, set diagonally to the walls which are an austere white without any decoration. Hints of wintergreen, pumpkins, roses, and strawberries drift through the air, each new scent bringing memories of seasons long past. A long white counter stands in the center of the room, featuring the exquisite wares of the shop.

node.name: Scentsations, Bespoke Bouquets
node.description: Glossy black tiles interrupt the otherwise white floor in a precise geometric pattern. The walls are similarly stark, the unembellished white relieved only by angled black trim running along the ceiling and baseboards. A simple counter of pale birch occupies the center of the room, the area cloaked in an overpowering melange of fragrances.

node.name: Scentsations, Functionally Fragrant
node.description: Heavy, almost overpowering scents dominate the room, each one warring with the other for preeminence. Besides a tall white counter, there is little in the room to distract from the overwhelming cacophony of scents that pervades the area. Spread across the display are the numerous bottles and vials of the shop's merchandise.

node.name: Seamwright's Fancy, Accentuating Accessories
node.description: A series of shallow alcoves interrupts the ivory-washed stone walls, each fitted with narrow brinewood shelves displaying neatly arranged accessories and decorative trinkets. Slender glass lanterns hang above a collection of polished counters, while embroidered runners and small ceramic dishes provide colorful accents throughout the space.

node.name: Fangs For The Memory, Sales Floor
node.description: Dark wooden walls loom beneath dim, flickering gaethzen lanterns, their warped planks draped in heavy fabrics that stir whenever a draft slips through the room. The floorboards creak beneath your feet, while thick curtains smother what little light remains, leaving the corners shrouded in darkness. A careless jumble of goods is displayed amongst the shadows.

node.name: Whimsical Winds
node.description: Polished haon walls holding a faint scent of beeswax are fitted carefully amongst driftwood planks. On one wall, a vibrant tapestry of the stylized image of Murrula playing a flute while engulfed in metallic threaded flames.

node.name: Gift Horse
node.description: The thick smell of leather hangs heavily in the air inside this small wagon. The walls all turn at odd angles, leaving very little flat wall space. Different sketches of horses are plastered over every surface, giving the effect of a giant collage. A large wardrobe stands against the tallest wall, between a saddle rack and a sturdy table.

node.name: Yaks and Packs, Front Room
node.description: The smell of finely tanned leather permeates this tidy tent. Oaken planks laid to make the floor have been recently swept clean, leaving not a scrap of debris in sight. A group of young Halflings dart around the pedestals, gesturing towards the tops of various poles scattered about this small tent, attempting to get someone to assist them with their purchases.

node.name: Wyrmtongue's Wares
node.description: Carved obsidian cases and tables have been methodically placed to maximize shopping space, allowing for a better view of the displayed wares. Large ironwood racks encircle the main shopping area, merchandise illuminated by thin planes of cerulean gaethzen placed on their shelves. Sparse rays of sunlight seep through the tent's flap, momentarily pushing back the unforgiving darkness within the tent.

node.name: Wyrmtongue's Wares
node.description: Numerous dark iron cones have been suspended from the ironwood ceiling beams, focusing the light from several gaethzen spheres to the shopping floor below. A large selection of furnishings has been meticulously arranged about this area of the tent, each piece encircled within halos of pale cobalt light. A darkly clad clerk meanders between the various wares on display, keeping a close watch on the gathered clientele.

node.name: Riding The Range, Sales Room
node.description: Fresh straw is covered by rustic mats to cushion the dirt floor. Colorful woven blankets, used pieces of harness and tack decorate the canvas walls.

node.name: Empombolius' Emporium
node.description: Colorful banners and streamers hang from the walls and ceiling. Multicolored gaethzen spheres hover among the streamers, sending bright light shimmering through the area, lending a festive sheen to the tent. A tall table built to resemble a bar is set against one side of the tent, holding wares for sale.

node.name: Liquid Assets, Sales Floor
node.description: Lights flicker through the sapphire curtains enclosing this room, giving the area an underwater feel. A white pedestal stands in the center of a variegated blue carpet. Water trickles from each corner of the pedestal into small trenches set into the raised floor, then continues to flow in a small stream until it disappears under the curtain.

node.name: A Cultured Attire, The Mountain Elves
node.description: A multitude of tapestries depicting majestic mountain ranges hang from the walls, representing a wide variety of styles. Willowy clerks glide from room to room, graceful despite the piles of clothing, weapons and armor that they carry.

node.name: A Cultured Attire, Accoutrements for Moody and Brooding Elves
node.description: Slender Elven clerks sidle in and out of the area, quietly replacing sold goods with fresh stock before leaving to carry out another task. Black curtains hang around the area, showing no particular emblem.

node.name: Albarian Imports, Trading Outpost
node.description: Rough-hewn stone walls support a ceiling of massive, closely spaced timbers. Heavy iron chains suspend shallow braziers above a floor of dark slate. Carved wooden panels depict longships, mountain peaks, and ranks of armored warriors. A chill draft slips beneath the iron-banded entrance door, carrying the faint scent of wet stone into the smoky chamber.

node.name: Something's Fishy
node.description: Large salt-stained nets are draped around the canvas walls, dotted with carefully preserved specimens from the sea. A large chandelier crafted from a ship's wheel hangs from the center of the ceiling, shedding light on the goods below.

node.name: Once Around, Sales Floor
node.description: Pastel fabrics in varying shades blend harmoniously in this cozy tent. A jeweled candle lamp with a gaily colored shade sits atop a display case, sandwiched between an angled shoe tree and a circular clothing rack.

node.name: Aura You Dressed Yet, Sales
node.description: Splashes of green and blue paint swirl across the oilcloth walls, the undulating lines set against a pitch-black background. The glitter mixed with the paint helps foster the illusion that the bands of color are shifting like the polar aurora in a wintry night sky. Shelves and other displays showcase the merchandise while discreet salespeople stand ready to answer questions.
